integrity: The first area moment is previously known; the second area moment value appeared previously under an unproved angle-density conjecture and is proved here by cyclic Dirichlet gaps. Classical integral identities are cited as prior ingredients. No priority or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only four independent uniform points on one circle and the first two joint moments are addressed; no full joint density or generalized sample distribution. Exact integrals are self-contained but broader historical implicit coverage is possible.
title: Exact perimeter–area second moments of a random cyclic quadrilateral
